पिट् {c1c} P. (पेटति)
1 To collect or
heap together.
--2 To sound.

पिटः A box basket.
--टं
1 A house,
hovel.
--2 A roof.

पिटकः --कं
1 A box, basket.
--2
A granary.
--3 A pimple, pustule,
small boil or ulcer; (also पिटका or
पिटिका in this sense); ततः
गंडस्योपी पिटका संवृत्ता Ś. 2.
--4 A kind of
ornament on the banner of Indra.
--5 A collection of writings. as
विनयपिटकं.
--का A small boil or
pimple.

पिटकः --कं
1 A box, basket.
--2
A granary.
--3 A pimple, pustule,
small boil or ulcer; (also पिटका or
पिटिका in this sense); ततः
गंडस्योपी पिटका संवृत्ता Ś. 2.
--4 A kind of
ornament on the banner of Indra.
--5 A collection of writings. as
विनयपिटकं.
--का A small boil or
pimple.

पिट्टकं The tartar of the teeth
(दंतकिट्ट).
